mostWorthwhile.text: Fitting the channels was most worthwhile because it connected their placement to how a message moves along a nerve cell.

leastWorthwhile.text: Developing the insulating cells felt more like following the named messenger pairing than figuring out how that development works.

surprise.text: I was surprised that a message can travel along the membrane without one ion traveling the whole length.

arbitrary.text: The developmental messenger pairings were clear from their names and pictures, but why those particular messengers cause development was not explained.

continue.text: I would choose to continue: the channel and insulation results made me curious about what nerve messages do next.
